Interface Consenting

All Known Subinterfaces:
Sequence
All Known Implementing Classes:
Action, ArrayPlan, Explanation, Plan, TailPlan, TemporalEdge
public interface Consenting
Provides methods to reason about which characters consent to a single action or sequence of actions.
Author:
Stephen G. Ware

  • Method Summary

    Modifier and Type
    Method
    Description
    Set<Character>
    consenting()
    Returns the set of characters who consent to this action or the set of all characters who consent to all of the actions in this sequence of actions.
    default boolean
    consents(Character character)
    Returns true if the given character consents to this action or to any action in this sequence of actions.
    default boolean
    isAuthor()
    Returns true if all action(s) have no consenting characters--that is, if this action or sequence of actions can be taken any time it is convenient for the story.
    default boolean
    isNPC()
    Returns true if this action or at least one action in this sequence is taken by a character which is not marked as a player (i.e. is a non-player character, or NPC).
    default boolean
    isNPCOnly()
    Returns true if this action or every action in this sequence is taken only by characters which are not marked as a players (i.e. are non-player characters or NPCs).
    default boolean
    isPlayer()
    Returns true if this action or at least one action in this sequence is taken by a character which is marked as a player.
    default boolean
    isPlayerOnly()
    Returns true if this action or every action in this sequence is taken only by characters which are marked as a players.

  • Method Details

    • isAuthor

      default boolean isAuthor()
      Returns true if all action(s) have no consenting characters--that is, if this action or sequence of actions can be taken any time it is convenient for the story. A sequence of zero actions is considered an author sequence.
      Returns:
      true if all of the action(s) have no consenting characters or if this is a sequence of zero actions

    • isPlayer

      default boolean isPlayer()
      Returns true if this action or at least one action in this sequence is taken by a character which is marked as a player. Note it is possible for an action or sequence to be taken by both player and non-player characters. If this is a sequence of zero actions, this method returns false.
      Returns:
      true if this action or at least one action in this sequence is taken by a player character
      See Also:
      • isPlayerOnly()

    • isPlayerOnly

      default boolean isPlayerOnly()
      Returns true if this action or every action in this sequence is taken only by characters which are marked as a players. If this is a sequence of zero actions, this method returns false.
      Returns:
      true if this action or every action in this sequence is taken only by player characters
      See Also:
      • isPlayer()

    • isNPC

      default boolean isNPC()
      Returns true if this action or at least one action in this sequence is taken by a character which is not marked as a player (i.e. is a non-player character, or NPC). Note it is possible for an action or sequence to be taken by both player and non-player characters. If this is a sequence of zero actions, this method returns false.
      Returns:
      true if this action or at least one action in this sequence is taken by a non-player character
      See Also:
      • isNPCOnly()

    • isNPCOnly

      default boolean isNPCOnly()
      Returns true if this action or every action in this sequence is taken only by characters which are not marked as a players (i.e. are non-player characters or NPCs). If this is a sequence of zero actions, this method returns false.
      Returns:
      true if this action or every action in this sequence is taken only by non-player characters
      See Also:
      • isNPC()

    • consents

      default boolean consents(Character character)
      Returns true if the given character consents to this action or to any action in this sequence of actions.
      Parameters:
      character - a character
      Returns:
      true if the character consents to this action or any action in this sequence of actions

    • consenting

      Set<Character> consenting()
      Returns the set of characters who consent to this action or the set of all characters who consent to all of the actions in this sequence of actions.
      Returns:
      the set of characters who take this action or this sequence of actions
